items.args: {"target": "location", "id": "5", "text": "The door does not mind being used twice. Beyond it the ground goes flat and grey, and nothing out there is waiting. Behind you the camp keeps its one coal warm for as long as you are gone."}

items.text: Gavin walked the whole world one last time — examined the goblin and the troll he could never reach before, thanked the woman at the cairn, then went out the Door a second time and got silence. I spoke one line at the Door so his exit landed, and left everything else alone.
